fixed_transmit_power_counterfactual: If only target reflectance varies, soft power can be independent of target intensity; current fixed-gamma normalization instead infers relative transmitted scale from the observed target. This ambiguity is not calibrated by these sensitivity curves.

default_receiver_unchanged.beta_policy: constant phase-function ratio beta/alpha from Hahner default MOR relation; unverified for spatially variable droplet size
default_receiver_unchanged.origin_policy: original hard when selected range is the exact target range and hard power dominates; pure soft is weather; shifted/mixed peaks unknown; component powers recorded
default_receiver_unchanged.receiver_policy: strongest total waveform peak; not the STF last-return selector
default_receiver_unchanged.threshold_status: uncalibrated_approximation: digital-encoding quantization only; no physical threshold assumed
